description:
Simulate a robots.txt change to block the 'Travel' category on 'https://books.toscrape.com/' using Screaming Frog's Custom Robots.txt feature. 

STEPS:
1. Go to Configuration > Robots.txt > Custom.
2. Add a rule to Disallow: /catalogue/category/books/travel_2/
3. Ensure the configuration is set to use 'Custom' (or 'Ignore Robots.txt' but respect Custom).
4. Crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'.
5. Verify that 'Travel' category URLs are blocked, while other categories (like Mystery) return 200 OK.
6. Export the 'Response Codes > Blocked by Robots.txt' report to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/blocked_urls.csv'.
7. Export the 'Internal > HTML' report (showing 200 OK pages) to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/allowed_pages.csv'.
